text: Agent Lorcalin is a Thalmor wizard assigned by Elenwen to hunt down Talos worshippers near one of the unmarked shrines. He is encountered during the quest "Elisif's Tribute."
The De Lisle is a bolt-action sniper rifle that features an integral suppressor. It was added to Call of Duty: WWII with the Liberty Strike update.

Aldaril is an Altmer battlemage stationed at Buckmoth Legion Fort south of Ald'ruhn in the Ashlands region. He is a Champion of the Imperial Legion, and will not speak to lower-ranking members who are out of uniform. He is not involved in any quests.

Alva is a Nord vampire and a resident of Morthal. She lives in her house in Morthal with the widower, Hroggar, and can be seen wandering around Morthal after dark. She is a vampire who was sent to Morthal by the master vampire Movarth to turn some townsfolk while preying on the rest. She is seen as uncaring and sees the townsfolk as nothing more than cattle, but her journal reveals a desire, at one point, for love and romance.

The Alessian Knight is a ghost that appears to the Vestige in a vision during the quest "Captured Time." He is part of the conversation near the Jolane Pilaster, and is talking with an Ayleid soldier. After a brief verbal exchange, he will kill the soldier, and disappear from sight.
The Death is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty Online. It can be switched between assault rifle and shotgun mode.

Ane Teria was a Dunmer mage, and one of the former Incarnates of the Nerevarine. As a failed incarnate, they reside in the Cavern of the Incarnate to help the present Incarnate of the Nerevarine during their quest.

Angof the Gravesinger is a Reachman necromancer and the leader of the Bloodthorn Cult in . He has allied himself with the Daedric Prince Molag Bal and attempted to corrupt the land of Glenumbra using dark magic. He is responsible for the resurrection of the werewolf Faolchu and the appearance of thorny roots throughout Glenumbra. His lair is in Cath Bedraud. He serves as the region's main antagonist. After his death, he can be encountered in Coldharbour at the Cliffs of Failure, participating in the Observer's "Game," where he is known as Angof the Undying. During the Game, Angof tells the Vestige that the reason he turned to Molag Bal was to gain the power to free Glenumbra from what he saw as the corrupt mechanisms of the Breton nobility. Of all the participants of the Game, Angof is the only one to have any form of remorse over what he had done, even willing to sacrifice himself to save the Mages Guild adepts.

Antus Flonius is an Imperial Warrior and member of the Fighters Guild in Leyawiin. He does not offer any training or services. He wears an iron cuirass and matching iron boots. In combat, he uses an iron sword and a shield. Antus spends all of his time in the guildhall.
The Daemon 3XB is a three-round burst firing submachine gun that was added to Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 with the Operation Absolute Zero update.
Apostle Marian is a member of the Rain Disciples trapped in the ruins of Bisnensel. She serves the water spirit of the Halcyon lake, Lorelia.
Anyaq is a Redguard summoner found with his Storm Atronach Zymel Ozarus in the Valley of Scars.
Arienne Kerbol is a Breton werewolf that resides in Kerbol's Hollow.

Damascus is the final Completionist camo in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile. It is unlocked obtaining all the Platinum camo for all weapon classes in Modern Warfare. In Call of Duty: Mobile, ALL gold camos for ALL weapons as of the current season must be acquired. For example, a player has to unlock gold on EVERY weapon released up to 2025 Season 11, alongside the SO-14, the gun added with 2025 Season 11 itself. In cases where a player has already unlocked Damascus, they still must complete all camos for any future weapons in order to receive it.
Archdruid Michiel is a Firesong Druid in . He was sent to the mainland from The Systres Archipelago to capture a nature spirit.

Assamanu Shashipal is a Dunmer Mabrigash who resides in the Ashlands of Morrowind. She is a Mabrigash, a blood sucking witch that preys on men. She can be found with her friends Nirai Ashishpalirdan and Pilu Shilansour in a small campsite between Bal Isra and Maar Gan. When approached they will attack the Nerevarine.
Athaedal is a Bosmer vampire residing in Shademist Moors in Greenshade, Valenwood. He is one of the three vampires responsible for the curse lingering there.

Deep Breath is a Weapon Kit available in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. It helps by increasing the player's breath duration so the player can keep aiming in and shooting for a longer period of time before making their presence known by breathing loud to enemy players.
Atub is an Orsimer mage who resides in the Orc stronghold of Largashbur and serves as the wise woman of her people. She also offers her services as an expert level trainer of Illusion.

Atrabhi is a Khajiit mage who resides in the town of Split as well as her twin. An experimenting mage split the town and its members into two halves. One half resembling Mania, while the other half looks and acts like Dementia. Atrabhi has little to do during her day and spends most of it bugging her counterpart and getting in the way of her reading. The Demented Atrabhi speaks the opposite of whats really going on around town, when first spoken to she will even deny her knowing about the other Atrabhi. She will also state that she loves her counterpart and would hate to see her get hurt. However, due to her tone, this is likely to be sarcasm.
Ayleid Ghost is the spirit of a deceased Ayleid appearing in the vault of Dresan Keep, Glenumbra. At first the Vestige cannot communicate with it, but they will find a way in the end.

The Decimator Shield is a wonder weapon featured in the Call of Duty: Vanguard Zombies maps Terra Maledicta and The Archon. The Decimator Shield is the cursed personification of the Decimator, an ancient warrior adhered to his own shield by Kortifex. In both maps, it can be obtained through a short quest.
Baezad-dro is a Khajiit ghost found on Khenarthi's Roost. He appears upon picking up the Journal of Bravam Lythandas.
Bandit Wizards are enemies in . Less common than the typical melee-based bandits, these bandits wield a variety of spells. When encountered in a group, the Bandit Wizard is usually the highest level.
Bandit Defiler is a generic Defiler residing in several locations in .

The Delay Bomb is a lethal equipment featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. It is exclusive to the Tank Battle and Ground War: Skirmish gametypes in Battle Royale mode. It was added in March 2021 as part of the Season 2: Day of Reckoning update. The Delay Bomb is an explosive that gets detonated a few seconds after being planted. Shooting the bomb will also make it explode immediately.

Baurus is a Redguard knight in and was the youngest member of the Blades during the last years of the Third Era. He was a key figure in the Oblivion Crisis and a member of the guard set to protect Uriel Septim VII in 3E 433 during the assassination of the Septim family. Though he failed to prevent the Emperor's death, Baurus would later gain a chance to rectify his failure when Uriel's last surviving heir, Martin Septim, was discovered. Working with the eponymous Hero of Kvatch, Baurus would uncover the identity of the Order of the Mythic Dawn, and would fight alongside Martin and the Hero during the Battle of Bruma as well as the Battle of the Imperial City.
Beem-Kiurz is an Argonian healer who is added in the official expansion.
Bats are creatures that can be found in damp, dark caves and dungeons. Bats travel in colonies and are non-aggressive, and cannot be killed.
Demo Weapon Systems is a weapons manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
Bear Cubs are baby bears that can be found in the wilderness of Wrothgar and Western Skyrim. They are usually accompanied by a grown bear or two. They cannot be harmed.

Berne Clan Archers are generic Imperial vampire poison archers residing in Galom Daeus, Vvardenfell, in . They are vampires, and a member of the Berne Clan. This enemy is always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no Disguises available to avoid combat.

Berne Clan Stalkers are generic Imperial vampire assassins residing in Galom Daeus, Vvardenfell, in . They are a Vampire, and a member of the Berne Clan. They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available Disguises to use to avoid combat.

Decals, also known as Large Decals or Weapon Vinyls, are a weapon customization option featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. Like the Weapon Stickers, Decals are applied on the weapon however they take a larger space limiting the players to apply only 1 Decal and 1 Weapon Sticker at the same time.
Blackheart Strongarm is a skeleton residing in Blackheart Haven.
Black Snail Pyromancer is a generic character residing in Vvardenfell. They are part of the Black Snails faction.

Bonewolves are creatures in expansion . As their name suggests, they are wolves constructed of bone, although they do contain some flesh. Bonewolves are created by black magic, and haunt the resting places of old graves on Solstheim. They are often found inside barrows.
Defense Group, abbreviated as DG is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
A Bone Hawk is a creature in . They bear a resemblance to regular hawks, but with a black hue and an exposed skull.
Bourlor is a character from the book Vernaccus and Bourlor, written by Tavi Dromio. Bourlor was said to be a Tamrielic Hero, famous for his unmatched skills in the art of Archery.

Bronrod the Roarer is a Nord healer who resides in the Skaal village. He is one of only two merchants in the village, offering alchemical items and a large selection of spells to local residents and travelers alike. Bronrod is not involved in any quests.
The is a battle rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It was added as part of the Season Six update.
Bron Darkhammer is a powerful Nord companion whose corpse has been found by local miners deep in the mine of Shor's Stone. His ghost can be interacted with.
Bumbub gro-Murgol is an Orsimer Healer residing in Valenvaryon.

Buron is a hostile Nord ghost, and a champion of the Crow's Wood public dungeon. He spawns in a cave just north of the burned-out house. Killing him counts towards the "Hero of Crow's Wood" and "Slayer of Crow's Wood" achievements.
The DS20 Mirage is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
Calvario is a vampire Acrobat located in the Nerano Ancestral Tomb. He is one of the few members of Clan Berne who are not found in Galom Daeus.

Calvus Horatius is an Imperial warrior in . He resides in the courtyard of the Royal Palace in Mournhold, Morrowind. For a small fee he can be hired to accompany the Nerevarine as a mercenary/bodyguard. Despite his class he does have some skill with magic and knows the useful healing spell Balyna's Perfect Balm.
Calixte Darkblood is a Breton necromancer found in Old Kalgon's Keep.
Deluxe Arcade is an event in Call of Duty: Mobile available between January 15th and February 8th, 2026. It is themed around the Street Fighter franchise.

Carahil is an Altmer Spellsword who heads the Mages Guild in Anvil. As a trainer of Illusion, she offers the additional service of providing the Anvil Recommendation to Associates of the Mages Guild. Her class is listed as Spellsword, and she possess the rank of Wizard in the Mages Guild. During the majority of the day, she stands at the front desk of the Anvil Mages Guild, reading a book. She wears the Black & Burgundy Outfit and Gold Trimmed Shoes.

Castus Philidus is a local mage and weather expert of Border Watch, a town in between Bravil and Leyawiin. He is questioned about the events in the edition of the Black Horse Courier; Rain of Burning Dogs!
Captain Serniel is a wraith that appears in Toadstool Hollow.

David may refer to: *David Tuey - A Private in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. *David Coen - A Private in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. *David Welsh - A tank Commander in Call of Duty 2. *David Ferguson - A Private and a playable character in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory. *David Vance - A Captain and a playable character in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS). *David Swenson - The Lead Sound Designer at Sledgehammer Games. *David "Section" Mason - A character in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. **David "Section" Mason/CoDM - The mobile iteration of Section. *David Petraeus - A character in Call of Duty: Black Ops II. *David Vonderhaar - Treyarch's game design director. *David "Hesh" Walker - The deuteragonist in Call of Duty: Ghosts. *David Archer - A character in the Extinction mode of Call of Duty: Ghosts. *Davidson (Ghosts) - A soldier in Call of Duty: Ghosts. *David "Prophet" Wilkes - A playable specialist in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. **David "Prophet" Wilkes/CoDM - The mobile iteration of Prophet. *David Hasselhoff - A character in the Zombies mode of Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. *David Schorn - A character in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. *David, Meet Goliath - A trophy in Call of Duty: WWII in The Tortured Path. *Davidson (Modern Warfare) - A Corporal in the United States Marine Corps in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. *Stacy Davidson - A civilian in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.

The Champion of the Mages Guild was a powerful Mages Guild member during the Third Era, and was responsible for the downfall of Mannimarco with the assistance of Hannibal Traven during the Attack on the Mages Guild. The Champion may or may not have been the Hero of Kvatch. After the defeat of Mannimarco and Hannibal's death, the Champion was made Arch-Mage of the Mages Guild in Cyrodiil.

Cephorus Septim I was the tenth ruler of the Empire of Tamriel. He was elected by popular consensus following the death of Uriel Septim III in 3E 127. According to one account, he was a "kind and intelligent ruler." However, Cephorus was also known as a great warrior.

The Cavern Patriarch is a very large and powerful male Netch found in Darkshade Caverns I in . It is an optional boss, but will likely need to be defeated in order to finish the quest "Mine All Mine."

Lieutenant Dimitri Volsky (Russian: Дмитрий Вольский) was a Red Army officer in the 13th Guards Rifle Division who fought at the Battle of Stalingrad. He was the unit leader in most of the Soviet campaign of Call of Duty 2. He appears to be good friends with Vasili.
Charvek-si is a Redguard healer in who resides in the court of Castle Sentinel and member of the Akatosh Chantry. She may offer The Agent noble quests.

Ashkhan Chodala, also known as Conoon Chodala, is a Dunmer ashlander who is the current Nerevarine incarnate and leader of the Urshilaku Tribe. He wields the divine staff Sunna'rah and leads the campaign to unite the Ashlander tribes in recognizing his position, also having allied himself with the Red Exiles. He is the brother of Seryn.
Clanfather Malifant, from his real name Ardwe Malifant, is a Bosmer crusader and a powerful Heretic leader residing in the ruins of Ebrocca.
The Digital Camouflage is a pattern of a weapon camouflage skin that appears in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered.

Conoon Chodala was a Dunmer Mage, and one of the former Incarnates of the Nerevarine. As a Failed Incarnate, he resides in the Cavern of the Incarnate to help the present Incarnate of the Nerevarine during their quest.
Crypt Dweller Drusilla is a powerful unique giant spider that appears in . She can be found in the Fulstrom Catacombs, guarding the exit to the surface.
A Daedra Spiderling is a creature summoned by a Spider Daedra that can paralyze its enemies.

The Dirty Harry (also known as "Holy Pistol"), is a weapon found in Call of Duty: World at War and Call of Duty: Black Ops. It is only available through cheats on the PC version of the games or through hacks on the console versions.

Dar-Ma is an Argonian sharpshooter and the only daughter of Seed-Neeus. She often helps her mother at Northern Goods and Trade in Chorrol. When traveling she makes use of a Paint Horse named Blossom. She also wrote Dar-Ma's Diary.

Danso Indules is a Dunmer healer and member of the Tribunal Temple who resides in Vivec City. She can be found outside High Fane in the city's Temple Canton. Danso serves the Archcanon Tholer Saryoni, and is also known to wander the city offering free healing services to the to the poor, which has attracted the attention of the Bal Molagmer. Danso is an essential character.

The Dagi are a small bipedal form of Khajiit who live in the trees of the Tenmar Forest in Elsweyr. They are supposedly able to move with great agility and remain in complete silence for extended periods of time with the use of magic. They are born when Masser is waning and Secunda is new. During the Five Year War in the late Third Era, the Dagi were said to be able to take up positions in the higher branches of trees that would not be able to hold a normal Bosmer's weight and would use their claws and fire from torches or spells to kill or otherwise distract Bosmer archers who had taken position in the lower branches. Reports from surviving Bosmer archers also claimed that the Dagi were accompanied by Alfiq, who bear an almost identical resemblance to common housecats and were responsible for spellcasting for the Dagi.
Devil One-One was the callsign of two F-15 Eagle fighter jets in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2.

Deetsan is an Argonian mage. Holding the rank of Magician, she is a member of the Cheydinhal Mages Guild during the final years of the Third Era. She is skilled in Alteration and can train others in its use up the novice-level. Deetsan is connected with the "Cheydinhal Recommendation" quest, helping the Hero by giving them the Buoyancy spell for free. After events involving the Hero of Kvatch's role as an Associate of the guild, she becomes the leader of Cheydinhal division after Falcar is ousted as a Necromancer and is exiled from the guild. Deetsan is considered the most caring of the Cheydinhal mages, and is very friendly to new Associates.
Dead Captain is a deceased Redguard found in the captains quarters on the ship Serpent's Wake, located in Anvil. When he is found he's lying on top of his bed and his spirit is roaming around.

Derek the Tall was one of the Nords' great War Chiefs during the First Era. He fought in the conquest of Morrowind, and helped found the First Empire. It is also known that he was one of the Tongues, the masters of the Voice.

The (DPV) is an underwater form of transport featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. It is a vehicle where the user grips onto the handles which can be turned forward to accelerate and vice versa. It's radar can detect friendlies with green dots, enemies with red dots and mines with a curved red line around the radar.
Dralora Athram is a Dunmer commoner, she is the wife of Ulen Athram and a Mythic Dawn member. She constantly bets at the Arena. She also wears a Luck imbued amulet that "helps her win Arena bets."
The Draugr Overlord is a variant of draugr and a powerful type of undead that typically serve as bosses or guardians in various draugr-filled dungeons.
Drathyn Andavel is a Dunmer battlemage and worshiper of Molag Bal residing in the ruins of Esutanamus.

The Dia de Muertos Camouflage is a downloadable weapon camouflage skin available for Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It is available for anyone who purchases the Dia de Muertos Pack for 160 MS Points or $1.99 USD through PlayStation Network.

Drawing-Flame was an Argonian highwayman who hailed from the province of Black Marsh. He lived during the Third Era, and was an accomplished illusionist. Drawing-Flame patrolled the roads in Black Marsh with his partner-in-crime, Furl-Of-Fresh-Leaves. They attempted to rob and kill Decumus Scotti, but were interrupted by Archein Right-Foot-Rock, an Argonian trader and plantation owner.
Drusilla Nerva is a Reachman necromancer and priestess residing on the island of Betnikh, Glenumbra. The Vestige will meet her during parts of the quest "The Bloodthorn Plot."

Druids are practitioners of magic. They wear light hooded armor with belt buckles and many pouches, and carry bright staves that can interact with their clothing. In the Illiac Bay they are responsible for bringing the bodies of the departed to their final resting place in the crypts. According to legend, Bretons are descended from a group known as the Druids of Galen, hence why they are quick witted and strong in the mystical arts. Modern Bretons still swear by a figure called the "ArchDruid", an unknown figure presumably important to their ancestral history. Among their practices include conducting services in parks, preparing nature-worshipping disciples, and finding human sacrifices. The Cowl of the Druid is a hood enchanted to enhance marksmanship, alchemy, and be able to detect life, suggesting druids specialize in these fields. They share a great many similarities with the Wyrds of Beldama and Glenmoril, who are the Druids over 100s of years.

Devastation is the second downloadable content pack for Call of Duty: Ghosts. Developers released a video on Instagram on March 5th showing a new gun and brief glimpses of new maps. On March 6, 2014, a preview video was released, showcasing the 4 new small-to-medium-sized maps, the new weapon, and Mayday, the next chapter of the Extinction saga. Devastation was released for Xbox One and Xbox 360 on April 3, 2014, and was released on May 8th for the PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4 and PC. It has a yellow color scheme in the 2nd Season Pass trailer.
Durgash gro-Rushub is a hostile Orsimer healer and Malacath worshipper who resides in Ashurnibibi. He holds an Ancient Daedric Key that unlocks the door to the room Joncis Dalomax is locked in.

The Dwemer (also referred to as the Dwarves, Deep-Elves, Deep Folk, Deep Ones, People of the Deep, Deep-Counseled or Secretive People or the under-Elves) were an ancient "Lost Race" of Mer who were remnants of the early Aldmer, and were primarily native to the region of Dwemereth. Mer used the term "Dwemer," roughly translated as "People of the Deep." The term also connoted "deep-delving," "profound," and "close-counseled." Men commonly refer to them as "Dwarves," in reference to the fables of the Giants seeing them as small. The Dwemer were an advanced race and civilization, in many respects far ahead of the other races and civilizations of their time. They are well known for their skill and revolutionary developments in technology, engineering, crafting methods, metalwork, stonework, architecture, city-planning, science, mathematics, magic, and the academic arts. The Dwemer are known for being the subjects of one of the greatest mysteries in all of Tamriel. In 1E 700, during the Battle of Red Mountain, for reasons still debated and under circumstances still under investigation, the Dwemer seemingly disappeared. It is still being debated who or what caused the Dwemer to disappear, as well as whether they disappeared all at once or over a long period of time.

Edla Dark-Heart is a Nord living in Bruma. It is unknown exactly why Edla left Skyrim, but most of the rumors say that she is on the run for murdering somebody at 300 yards. Also sometimes, if you have a horse, she will attack it, and the guards will attempt to attack her, but she pays a fine.
Digital Classic Camouflage is a weapon camouflage skin that appears in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.
Ebral the Betrayer is a Xivkyn necromancer in . He is found in the westernmost room of the Antediluvian Vaults, and is one the champions of the Imperial City Sewers. He summons minions in battle.
Elanande is an Altmer battlemage who resides in the district of Godsreach, Mournhold.
Eldellar is an Altmer who can be found performing arcane skirmishes in Colosseum of the Old Ways in Artaeum. He cannot be interacted with.

The Dive Boat is a vehicle in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. In the level "Utopia", Jack Mitchell escapes in one. The boat is capable of going underwater temporarily, allowing it to evade boats and other obstacles, like missiles.
Emi'liah is a powerful Nereid found inside the ruins of Shada's Tear.
Elossi, the Sudden Gust is an Argonian found at Stonewastes in .
Enie the Agile is a Redguard street performer found on a street in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Disco Camouflage is a weapon camouflage in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It is available with the purchase of the Disco Pack.

Erandur is a Dunmer healer who can be found at the Windpeak Inn in Dawnstar. Early in his life, he was inducted into a cult dedicated to the Daedric Prince Vaermina. After he grew up, he left the order, changing his name from Brother Casimir to Erandur, and dedicating his life to Mara. He is also a temporary protagonist during the Daedric Quest: Waking Nightmare. During the Civil War, the Dragonborn may have assisted him with eradicating Vaermina's cult, after several citizens of Dawnstar fell victim to gruesome nightmares. After, he may have joined the Dragonborn as a follower, potentially becoming recruited into The Blades.

Esunil the Fleet is a Bosmer residing in one of The Anemone's prison cells. He can be found there during the quest "Prison Break." After being released from the cage he cannot be interacted and will disappear from the game.
Falarel the Jester is an Altmer ghost found at Castle Rilis in Auridon.
The Dingo is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Mobile.
Faltha is a Dunmer who has been transformed into a skeever by a mage on Bleakrock Isle.
Fangaril is a powerful werewolf that is sometimes summoned at Dark Anchors across Tamriel. It can also be encountered in Grayhome during "The Gray Council".

Fenrig is a fallen Nord warrior and the lover of Ruki. His ghost can be found just south of Greenspring Hollow. He died in battle, but their commitment was so strong that they remained ghosts until reunited. Once reunited with Ruki, their ghosts will float up into the air and be lost to sight, heading to Sovngarde.

Dr. Monty's Factory is an interactive section of the main menu in the Call of Duty: Black Ops III Zombies mode. It allows the player to craft GobbleGum Power-Ups using Liquid Divinium, which are used at the respective GobbleGum machine featured in every map in the game. It is ran by and named after Dr. Monty.

Farvyn Oreyn is a Dunmer battlemage who resides in the Bitter Coast region of Vvardenfell. He is the descendant of the legendary elven hero Oreyn Bearclaw and relative to Modryn Oreyn. He is accompanied by two bodyguards.
Ferordomas is an Altmer necromancer residing in the Craglorn city of Belkarth. He is the author of Couplets in Admiration of the Dead.

Festus Krex is an Elder Imperial member of the Dark Brotherhood. His weapon of choice for contracts is magic, stating that "there is a spell for every circumstance." He is the self-described "cranky old uncle who nobody talks to" of the Dark Brotherhood family at the Falkreath Sanctuary.

The Dischord is a wonder weapon that appears in the Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare Zombies map, Zombies in Spaceland. It is one of the Weapons of Rock, four powerful handguns of Alien origin. When fired, the Dischord causes zombies to rapidly headspin and create a wave motion effect, instantly gibbing and killing nearby zombies.
Fillia is a Bosmer Ghost located in Sweetbreeze Cottage, Grahtwood, in .
Frost Mage Porcia is an Imperial member of the Blackcaster Mages Guild. She is found in the ruins of Balamath.

Gaius Prentus is a Bravil guard who monitors the entrance to the Shivering Isles. He is serious about his job, making sure that nothing dangerous exits the gate. Not long after the Hero arrives, he proves this when Belmyne Dreleth exits the gate and becomes insane, which lead to him being put down. The only person who has exited the gate and been spared is S'fara, who believes she is invisible and has remained peaceful. Once the Hero accepts Haskill's offer to enter the isles, Gaius refuses to talk to them because they have spent too much time on the other side.
The Dome Shield is a tactical equipment featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is unlocked at level 20.
Galsa Andrano is a Dunmer healer residing in the infirmary of Mournhold's Temple.
Garach Wolf-Father is a ghost and world boss located at Lakewatch Tower, Bangkorai, in .
Ghost of Old Hroldan is a Nord ghost who has been haunting Old Hroldan Inn. He has been waiting for "Hjalti" to bring his sword, so that they can be sworn as brothers.

The Dispersion Muzzle is an attachment featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is integral to the Erad submachine gun and it reduces recoil; providing the Erad with the highest accuracy in it's class.

Valdemar is an Ghost Nord Blade inside Sancre Tor. He was one of the mightiest Blades from the time of Tiber Septim, but now guards the prison section of Sancre Tor. He, along with Rielus, Casnar and Alain, were trapped there.
Gilas Llervu is a Dunmer battlemage and member of a bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold Andasreth. He can be found on the upper level, and will be hostile towards the Nerevarine.

Giant Rats are creatures that appear in . They are the first creatures encountered in the game. They have low health and strength values, but they can move fairly quickly. Their attacks have a five percent chance per hit of transmitting a disease.

Double Barrel is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the Epic Trek-50 - Ranger variant. It gives the weapon an extra barrel, giving the Trek-50 an additional shot in its "magazine" before reloading.
Glannison is a Redguard bandit Healer, and resides in the cave of Beshara. He will attack any intruders in the cave on sight.
Ghostly Brute is a ghostly warrior that appears in . It can be found in the Alessian Tombs area of the Imperial City Sewers.
Ghostly Archer is a ghostly archer that appears in . It can be found in the Alessian Tombs area of the Imperial City Sewers.
The Doom is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty Online. It can switch between assault rifle and sniper rifle mode.
Gullveig is a Nord member of the Worm Cult leading the forces found at Lost Prospect. She becomes a Lich using one of the shards of Wuuthrad along with the souls of those imprisoned in the mine.
Hamelyn is a mad Breton mage who lives underneath the Honningbrew Meadery outside Whiterun.
Hadring the Swift is a Nord found in Windhelm. He is one of the runners taking part in the Footrace of the Nine Holds, one of the many events in the Konunleikar.
The DoubleCross is a double-barreled assault rifle that was added to Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 with the Operation Dark Divide update.

Hears-Voices-in-The-Air is an Argonian mage residing in the basement of the Blackwood Company Hall. He and Sings-Like-Thunder, another Argonian mage, maintain a very special and important tree, the Hist Tree (their ancestors). He is wearing a leveled staff and jewelry.
Healer Alezan is a Breton healer residing in Glenumbra. He takes care of the wounded at Lion Guard Redoubt.
Healer Teldyni is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is found in Jorunn's Stand, tending to wounded soldiers.

The ("Double Type 96 25mm AT/AA Gun") is an anti-aircraft weapon of World War II, featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It appears in the level Numa Numa Trail where it shoots down Wade Jackson’s S-17 over the island of .
Healer Urila is a Dunmer member of the Pact. She is found in Jorunn's Stand, tending to wounded soldiers.
Hardtack is a spectral monkey found at the Wreck of the Raptor in Auridon.

Heloise Menoit is a Breton healer of the Shornhelm City Guard found assisting the wounded soldiers at Hinault Farm. In the midst of the chaos, she was assaulted by bloodfiends and turned into a vampire.

The Dobrych 4x is an optic featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for Assault Rifles, LMGs, Marksman Rifles and Sniper Rifles.

Hert is a Nord vampire who lives at the Half-Moon Mill. She lives a quiet life working at the Half-Moon Mill with her husband Hern. While living a seemingly normal life, the Dragonborn will find out that Hert and her husband are both vampires who feed off of travelers who pass by their mill, this way they can feed and remain in the sunlight.

The High Elves hail from the island province of Summurset. They are a race of tall, brown or gold-skinned people with almond-shaped eyes. High Elves are extremely intelligent, agile, and willful. High Elves seem drawn to magic as a moth is to flame; they have a natural affinity to its use, and make quite formidable wizards. High Elves are naturally immune to paralysis. They are adept at any art involving the arcane.
Hleran Deadeye is a Dunmer ghost and Hleran family ancestor residing in Hleran Ancestral Tomb.

The Dobrych MF Reflex is a red dot right featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for Assault Rifles, SMGs, Shotguns and LMGs.

Hrol Ulfgar is a Nord warrior residing in his house in the village of Bleaker's Way north of the Imperial City. Villagers of Bleaker's Way will occasionally say in regard to Hrol, "He leads the Ulfgar clan. He is slow to anger, but fierce with his axe. All the clan values his leadership and judgement."

Icarian is a deceased Bosmer mage found at an island in a lake south of Dragonclaw Mine, southeast of Fort Dragonclaw, and northeast of Bruma. His experience is recorded in his log, revealing he has been trying to fly, and his latest attempt resulted in his death as the impact from falling killed him.
Ice Atronach is a creature in . They are immune to frost damage and may be healed instead.

Double Kill is a Weapon Perk featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, available to most submachine guns (minus the Striker 45, ISO, USS 9, VMP, Sten, LC10, FSS Hurricane, and Static-HV), as well as the Groza assault rifle and the L-CAR 9 pistol.

Idrenie Nerothan was Imperial Mage and one of the former Incarnates of the Nerevarine. As a failed incarnate, she resides in the Cavern of the Incarnate to help the present Incarnate of the Nerevarine during their quest.

Ilvel Romayn is a Dunmer worshipping the Daedric Prince Peryite. He is frozen in a trance that relates to the Daedric Princes quest, but can be unfrozen in completion the quest "Peryite." He is unable to be killed without finishing the Peryite quest. Ilvel wears Monk Robes, is armed with an Iron Dagger, and carries a few Septims.

The Ideal Masters are mysterious entities that lord over the Soul Cairn, controlling every aspect of its reality, similar to how a Daedric Prince does with their plane of Oblivion. They are an enigma to the inhabitants of Tamriel, and only those who make deals with them or have visited the Soul Cairn know of their existence. Most individuals who deal with the Masters are deceived, and subsequently their souls are condemned to the Soul Cairn. While there are theories, exactly why the Ideal Masters crave souls is unknown.
The Destroyed Armor Plating is a special item in Blackout within Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. It is used to unlock Kerk "Ajax" Rossouw as a playable character within Blackout.
Iirenoore is an Altmer bandit sorcerer resideing at the cave of Yesamsi.
Ilzheven is wife to Ezhmaar Sul. She appears as a ghost in the events of .

Indaenir is a Bosmer in who resides in Greenshade, Valenwood. He works with the Vestige to fight against the corruption caused by the Servant of Naemon. He later becomes The Silvenar after sacrificing himself to save the Heart of Valenwood.
The Dodge WC series was a light duty truck used by the Allies during World War II, as seen during the events of Call of Duty 3.
Insane Wanderers are considerably high-level werewolves on the island of Solstheim. Insane Wanderers are one of many werewolf templates that can be encountered on Solstheim.

Irarak is a vampiric Dunmer acrobat who resides in Morrowind. He can be found in Ginith Ancestral Tomb just west of Gnisis. Irarak is part of the Berne vampiric bloodline, but is not a member of the Berne Clan.
J'Ghasta is a Khajiit Speaker of the Dark Brotherhood's Black Hand in . He resides at his home in the city of Bruma, where he spends most of his time training himself in unarmed combat.

The , also referred to as the SVD, is a Soviet semi-automatic sniper rifle featured in many games of the Modern Warfare series, as well as in Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Heroes, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It also makes a brief cameo in Call of Duty: Ghosts and Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.

J'skar is a Khajiit mage apprentice at the Bruma Mages Guild. He is also an Apprentice Destruction trainer. He is the only survivor of the Bruma Mages Guild destruction during the quest "A Plot Revealed." J'skar is the prankster of the Bruma Mages Guild along with his accomplice, Volanaro.

Isobel is an Imperial Glenmoril Wyrd found in the Gloomy Cave in Solstheim. Isobel and her two sisters Ettiene and Fallaise have traveled from High Rock to Skyrim to Solstheim to help those with the lycanthropy disease.
Irrai is a Winged Twilight who is found in Vastarie's Tower in Grahtwood.
The Elefant (or Panzerjäger Tiger (P)) is a German heavy tank destroyer based on the Tiger P tank.
Janus Hassildor is the Count of Skingrad and is reputed to be a powerful mage.
Jeetum-Ze is an Argonian recruiter of the Blackwood Company in Leyawiin. He also handles the recruitments to the Blackwood Company. He is a skilled Warrior and Mage, making him proficient Battlemage.

Jayred Ice-Veins is a Nord sharpshooter in who resides in the town of Passwall. Like most people in the Shivering Isles, Jayred has a shade of madness in him. In his case, he is obsessed with the collection of bones, and believes that they speak to him after he kills something. This obsession can be of some assistance in killing the Gatekeeper on the path to gaining access to the land past the Fringe.
Private Ehlrich was a soldier part of the 1st Infantry Division who fought under the command of Lieutenant Walker, as seen during the events of Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Jantus Brolus is an Imperial spellsword who lives with her husband Istirus Brolus in their house in Bruma. She trains Illusion skills on an apprentice level, from 6:00 AM until 10:00 PM every day.
Jart is a Redguard Healer who can be found at the Daedric Shrine Assalkushalit.

Junal-Lei is an Argonian acrobat living in the Ascadian Isles region of Vvardenfell. He can be found outside his house, one of the largest residences in the town of Pelagiad, tending to his Corkbulb garden both night and day. Junal-Lei wears common clothing, and although the door to his home is locked, he does not carry a key. He does not offer any services, and is not involved in any quests.

(also referred to as Akimbo) is a weapon attachment available in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One and in every main game in the series since Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2. The term "akimbo", used in most games except Big Red One and the Black Ops series, comes from a human body position, but is commonly used in popular culture as a synonym for dual-wielding.

Kaie is a Breton Reachwoman and a member of the Forsworn in Markarth. Skilled with magic, she is involved with the quest "No One Escapes Cidhna Mine." She will follow Madanach to Druadach Redoubt where she will take up residence.

Kalina Telvanni is a Dunmer mage of House Telvanni and a member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Orsinium. Speaking with her uncovers that she, similar to other members, is unsatisfied with the Mages Guild facilities provided by King Kurog.

K'avar is a Redguard Lord, knight, and commander of the Order of the Candle in Sentinel. A veteran of the War of Betony, he received a disfiguring injury during a battle in the Glenpoint Foothills from a fireball cast by a Dark Elf nightblade.

The Dual Mags (shortened from "Dual Magazines") is a weapon attachment that appears in Modern Warfare 2: Ghost, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.

Josian Kaid is a novice battlemage who entered the Battlespire shortly before the Apprentice did, and was trapped during the Daedric invasion. He leaves them helpful letters and items, as the Apprentice follows in his footsteps through the chaos. He is found in Dagon's Hunting Lodge, held prisoner by the Daedra Prince Mehrunes Dagon in his inner sanctum behind a Hekem Sigil of Warding. He is found barely-clothed hanging from the ceiling, wrists tied with rope and appears to be unconscious or in a deep sleep.

Kasura is an old childhood friend of Blademaster Sai Sahan in . She is a former instructor at the Abbey of Blades in the Valley of Blades in Hammerfell, which was where Sai Sahan trained to become a warrior during his childhood. Kasura taught the art of body, blade and brilliance to the students there.

Kelmen Locke is a drunkard Breton conjurer and a former member of the Mages Guild held hostage by the Greycloak Mercenaries in Haddock's Market. After he is freed, he takes up refuge at the Star-Gazers' Observatory in Belkarth and helps in the efforts alongside Titus Valerius and Hara against the Serpent and the Scaled Court.
Dusty Camouflage is a type of weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops.

King Laloriaran Dynar (Ayleidoon: Ruler in Dark Times), remembered in history as The Last King of the Ayleids, was an Ayleid who lived during the First and Second Eras. He ruled over the city of Nenalata when it was a vassal-state of the Alessian Empire, and later went on to found Bisnensel and win the Battle of Glenumbra Moors. He was deposed after a conflict with the Primeval Seekers, a Hermaeus Mora cult. He and his family fled to Balfiera, where he begged refuge of the Direnni. He was captured by Molag Bal shortly after Meridia pushed Delodiil into Coldharbour. He was the last known surviving member of his race, which he explains is possible due to Meridia's blessings and Coldharbour's time-warping nature. He can initially be found in the Lightless Oubliette, a tower which he was imprisoned in by Molag Bal. After being freed, Dynar takes command of the Fighters Guild, and plays a key role in the Main questline. Dynar dies in the Chapel of Light of wounds received near the end of The Final Assault.

Kirel Aman is a Wraith encountered in the Soul Cairn in . In life, he was the Praeceptor Superior of Battlespire, and was killed along with all those with him. Aman asks the Apprentice to free him through a necromantic ritual that will ultimately destroy his soul, but leave behind a powerful healing gem in its place.
The Knight of the Ivory Lord is the ghost of a knight located in Burial Mounds, Glenumbra, in .
ERDL Camouflage is a type of Weapon Camouflage in Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

Kurz gro-Baroth is an Orsimer and a member of the Fighters Guild in Chorrol, and is the brother of Lum gro-Baroth. He does not offer any services or training. He spends most of his time practicing, either with an axe in the Guild basement, or with a bow in the back yard. When he's practicing Archery, he's a good never-ending source of free arrows, since he keeps shooting at the target and never runs out of arrows.

Kvenel the Tongue is a unique spectral draugr. He can be found within the dungeon Volunruud. According to a set of notes found earlier in the dungeon, Kvenel is the leader of the legendary Tongues, powerful warriors capable of using Dragon Shouts.
Lagakh gra-Lorga is an Orsimer healer residing in the Dwemer Ruin of Mzuleft.

Elite Member Camouflage is a weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It was available for anyone who signed up for the free Call of Duty ELITE service within Call of Duty: Black Ops II on Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3, and available by default for everyone on PC after April 12, 2013 (before which it was unavailable). Currently it is available to all players by default, due to the fact that ELITE has been shut down. The camouflage consists of the ELITE skull icons in dark orange, on a brighter orange background.
Lanald is a Redguard healer who resides in the cave of Ahinipalit, in the region of Molag Amur.

The Lamia Spellslinger is a lamia that appears in . They are reoccurring creatures that appear through many quests and locations, and may or may not be hostile. For more information, see the main article.
The Languishing Remnant is a Dunmer ghost found in Crow's Wood.

The Eland is a South African scout car. It mounts a 90mm, low-recoil gun on a very small chassis. Several Elands appear in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, manned by Jonas Savimbi and his UNITA troops. Although fairly ineffectual against opposing T-62 tanks, they form the heavy vanguard of his initial counterattack against the Marxist MPLA.

Leki is the goddess of aberrant swordsmanship and daughter of Tall Papa. The Na-Totambu of Yokuda warred to a standstill during the Mythic Era to decide who would lead the charge against the Lefthanded Elves. Their swordmasters, though, were so skilled in the Best Known Cuts as to be matched evenly. Leki introduced the Ephemeral Feint; afterwards, a victor emerged and the war with the Aldmer began.
Lesley is a Redguard healer and bandit, who resides in the cave of Nund.
Lenendore is a powerful Altmer Vampire lord hiding in the ruins of Goldfolly.

The Dragon Camouflage is a DLC weapon camouflage skin available for Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It is available for anyone who buys the Dragon Pack for 160 MS Points on Xbox 360. Its main features are scales of varying colors which reflect light. There are cracks in the scales which reveal lava flowing steadily through the scales on the gun.
Letreius Muco is an Imperial Healer residing in the Canalworks of the Vivec City's Foreign Quarter.
Llaalamu Sathren is a Dunmer healer and member of the Tribunal Temple who resides in the Hlaalu Temple.

Lilatha is an Altmer sorceress who is a member of the Psijic Order. Later on, when the Vestige finally arrives in Artaeum, she can be found in one of the gardens reading a book. She does not regret losing her shadow and her arcane powers from Nocturnal's machinations, but is rather glad she has become a great teacher to initiates and would gladly pass on wisdom to her students.

Captain Elias T. Walker, also known as Scarecrow, was the tritagonist in Call of Duty: Ghosts and the playable character in Legends Never Die. He was a retired U.S. Army Captain prior to the ODIN strikes and the acting commander of the Ghosts. He was also the father of David and Logan Walker and the original handler of Riley. He was also a customization option in Multiplayer and Extinction.

Lugrub gro-Ogdum is an Orsimer warrior located in the Gnisis Eggmine in Gnisis. He is responsible for killing Mansilamat Vabdas, and thus is the guilty party in the Widow Vabdas' Deed Imperial Legion quest. He is in fact tasked with guarding the lower eggmine, where the sick Kwama Queen resides. He warns approaching people to leave within seconds, else he attacks.

Lorenz Bog-Trotter was a Nord knight. His ghost resides on the Hill of Suicides. At some point, Lorenz decided to kill himself. The law in the Shivering Isles forces the spirits of the undead to be trapped on the hill until they are reunited with their remains. Lorenz's remains can be found in Knotty Bramble.
Madres Navur is a Dunmer acrobat who resides in Pelagiad, Morrowind. He can be found inside his home in the western side of town.
Ducky Personalization Pack is a downloadable content package available for Call of Duty: Ghosts. It contains a weapon camo, reticle, a player background and a player patch.
M'desi was a Khajiit knight. His ghost resides on the Hill of Suicides.

Makela Leki is an ancient Redguard hero who is now a ghost. She is found at HoonDing's Watch in the Alik'r Desert, and later at the Hall of Heroes. At age 11, Makela Leki began training as a sword-singer in the Hall of the Virtues of War. She died fighting against an invasion led by King Joile of Daggerfall.

Manheim Maulhand is a Nord publican in and is the innkeeper at the Inn of Ill Omen located roughly halfway between the Imperial City and Bravil. If provoked, Manheim will equip iron boots and greaves and use a leveled warhammer.

The Elias Multiplayer Skin is a downloadable character skin available for Call of Duty: Ghosts. It is the skin that is worn by Elias Walker when rappeling down with Keegan Russ in the level Homecoming, while rescuing Elias' sons.
Marashi is a Khajiit magister of the Mages Guild branch in Mournhold.
Martina Floria is an Imperial mage in the Mages Guild. She also recharges enchanted weapons and is the Master Illusion Trainer. Martina can be found in the Chironasium of the Arcane University.
Margonet is a Redguard Battlemage residing in Tel Mora, Morrowind. She is a member of House Telvanni.
The EM1 (ElectroMagnetic-1) is a directed-energy weapon featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare and Call of Duty: Vanguard.
Master Abrunul is a powerful Redguard warrior found at the Rahni'Za, School of Warriors.
Master Drenim is a Dunmer residing in Balmora, Vvardenfell, in . He is a House Telvanni mage and a master of Gilan Lerano.
Maxelle Carsitien is a member of the Thieves Guild residing in the Thieves Den in the city of Abah's Landing. She is also a pyromaniac.
The Drop Pod is a vehicle that appears in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.
Medild the Fleet is a Nord found in Windhelm. She is one of the runners taking part in the Footrace of the Nine Holds, a part of The Konunleikar.

Mercano is an Altmer residing at the Thalmor Headquarters in Woodhearth, Greenshade. He is the author of Mercano's Journal. His wife died from a plague long ago, and Mercano tried to raise her from the dead, as detailed in his journal. The Veiled Heritance creates liches using his journal, unbeknownst to him.

Melita Hinault is a Breton hiding from rampaging bloodfiends with the rest of her family at their farm just outside Shornhelm. While the Vestige is out collecting weapons for them to defend themselves, the fiends managed to break into the farm house, killing the father Gennove and forcing the rest of the family to escape. When Melita is found, she has already been turned into a bloodfiend herself and must be put down.

The EPM3 is a heavy directed energy weapon in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. The EPM3 is a semi-automatic weapon that uses a miniature fusion reactor to generate and fire hardened bolts of condensed energy at range; under prolonged fire, the reactor overheats and automatically retracts to vent, before being pushed back in and regulated. Not having a traditional trigger, the EPM3 has a side-mounted pistol grip that allows the weapon to be carried and fired.
Mila Valentia is an Imperial girl in who mostly runs and plays tag with Lars Battle-Born and Braith around Whiterun. She is the daughter of Carlotta Valentia, and her father is dead.
Merthida is a Nord werewolf encountered in the Lightless Hollow, Greymoor Caverns, during the quest "The Vampire Scholar" in .

Molag Bal (Daedric script: , "Stone-Fire") is the God of Schemes and the Daedric Prince of domination and enslavement of mortals. He is also known by the titles King of Rape, King of Strife, Schemer Prince and Schemer Princess, Harvester of Souls, Father of Coldharbour and Lord of Lies. He is the creator of Vampires and Xivkyn as well. His main desire is to harvest and consume the souls of mortals and to bring mortals' souls under his sway by spreading seeds of strife and discord in the mortal realms and has even attempted to merge Nirn with his own freezing realm of Coldharbour. He holds much importance in Morrowind where he is one of the Four Corners of the House of Troubles, seen as the arch-enemy of Boethiah, the Daedric Prince of Plots. He is the primary antagonist of .
The Drone Swarm is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.

Morbash gro-Shagdub is an Orsimer Warrior in Fort Pelagiad, Vvardenfell. According to the prisoner log he is currently serving time for starting a fight at the Halfway Tavern in Pelagiad, and for damaging property, including several chairs, two windows, and a table. Morbash is paying off his debt by doing hard labor.
Murob gra-Loghash is an Orsimer Healer, and worshipper of Malacath residing in Dushariran.

Murk-Scale is an Argonian healer that has taken shelter, like most of the other residents, within the Elinhir sewers away from the renegade Blackcaster Mages Guild. He tends to the bodies of the deceased.

The Egg Bowl is a bonus round of Dead Ops Arcade II: Cyber's Avengening in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. Similarly to Redins Rally, players drive a truck around the area. However, instead of racing, players must attempt to get all of the eggs into the two baskets within the time limit, or else it counts as a fail.
Nanette Don is a Breton sorcerer, and the apprentice of Relmyna Verenim. She lives in Passwall, and is abused by Relmyna for even the slightest mistake.

Naenra Waerr was an ancient witch who enchanted the infamous sword Umbra for the sole purpose to entrap souls. She was eventually executed for her creation, but not before she was able to hide the sword. Some people speculate that Naenra Waerr was in fact Sheogorath in disguise.
Nasimar is a Khajiit healer and member of the Aldmeri Dominion. He is tending to wounded soldiers in Eagle's Strand.

The EBR-800 (referred to as M8 in the game files) is an EDI energy sniper rifle that appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. As a hybrid weapon, the EBR-800 functions as a semi-automatic sniper rifle capable of converting to a fully automatic assault rifle for mid-to-close range engagements.

Narama-ko is a Khajiit sorcerer that has set up camp outside the Abode of Ignominy. She is a member of the Mages Guild, looking for a way to ressurect a frog. After the quest "An Animal's Grim Abode" is completed, she will leave her camp.
Na'ruzz the Boneweaver is a Khajiit necromancer and group boss found residing in The Bone Pit.
Nerile Andaren is a Dunmer healer found at the Hall of Ministry at the Mournhold Temple. She sells some potions and spells.
The Elephant is a large mammal which would have been able to ridden in Call of Duty: Roman Wars as a vehicle.
Nimriian, also known as Longfang, is a Bosmer werewolf and leader of the Wolfpack. She acts as the boss of Weeping Wind Cave.
Nivel Madryon is a Dunmer Battlemage who resides in the cave of Hinnabi. Madryon is hostile towards the Nerevarine, and will engage them when they are within combat range.
Nolonir is an Altmer necromancer found within the Ayleid ruins of Wansalen. He acts as the boss of the delve.

The Dragon Strike is a Wonder Weapon that appears in the Call of Duty: Black Ops III Zombies map Gorod Krovi. The weapon can be used to mark a certain location for the Dragons to fire at whilst luring the Zombies into the location of attack. It is used during the Easter Egg quest, Love and War.
Niralin is an Altmer and a werewolf in . Esterdel is her betrothed.
Noveni Othran was a Dunmer necromancer residing at Wellspring Cave in Cyrodiil.
Novor Drethan is a Dunmer Battlemage found at the Dissapla Mine in Morrowind. He has hired the Fighters Guild to help him remove the Nix-hounds troubling him in the cave.
Dragon Skin Camouflage is a type of weapon camouflage skin that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered.

Nymphs are rare and mysterious beings found in High Rock and Hammerfell. They have the ability called Energy Leech that drains fatigue on touch. All of the species seem to be female and are usually described as beautiful, naked women.

Olur is an Orsimer warrior residing in the Orc stronghold of Mor Khazgur in Haafingar. He is the son of Shuftharz, one of the chief's wives and Forge-wife. He was taught smithing by his mother and now he tends the mine and the forge, spending most of his time near the smelter.

Orchendor is a Bosmer mage in and the primary antagonist of the quest "The Only Cure," having taken up residence deep within Bthardamz. He is also mentioned in the Afflicted's Note found in the upper portion of Bthardamz.

Eighty Seven is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the Epic variant of the Type-2, the Butcher. It converts the weapon's akimbo auto-pistol mode into a semi-automatic akimbo shotgun mode, allowing for devastating damage at closer ranges.
Only-He-Stands-There is an Argonian healer located at the South Wall Cornerclub in Balmora. Unlike most residents there, he is not a member of the Thieves Guild.

Orintur is an Altmer spell merchant in the Cheydinhal Mages Guild, where he holds the office of Magician. He has a variety of Alteration spells for sale and can usually be found in his room upstairs, or sometimes on the main floor. He sells spells from 8:00AM to 08:00PM. Orintur is married to fellow Mages Guild member, Eilonwy, both of whom boast their happy relationship. When speaking to Eilonwy, she will remark on how Orintur is a skilled mage and has an unmatched reflect spell. While Orintur and Eilonwy own Willow Bank, Orintur is rarely there, spending most of his time in the guild.
Packleader Sigmund is a powerful Nord Werewolf and member of the Greycloak Mercenaries found inside Hircine's Haunt.

Dual Barrels appear as an attachment integrated to the VPR submachine gun in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It allows the VPR to have increased bullets down range and faster reloads, which could save the user a weapon and attachment slot while also having a tactical advantage over the enemy.

Pelladil Direnni was a member of the Direnni Dynasty who was mentioned as one of many famous members of the bloodline in the book De Rerum Dirennis. It is known, thanks to the works of Vorian Direnni, that Pelladil "had a similar role with the first Potentate" as Jovron Direnni did to Empress Katariah, and "encouraged the Guild Act without which we would not have all the professional organizations we have today." His grandson was Jovron Direnni, and his great-great granddaughter was Medora Direnni. Pelladil allegedly summoned an army of Stone Atronachs to build Blackrose Prison from the ruins of various nearby Lilmothiit ruins, under orders from Potentate Versidue Shaie.
Plague Bears are creatures in . A plague bear is a carrier of the disease Ataxia and is resistant to Paralysis.
Pit Rat Mender is a Dunmeri Healer of the Pit Rats. Located in Darkshade Caverns I in .

Dynamic is a Legendary gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found upon certain weapon variants. It is exclusive to weapon variants with alternate firing modes and allows the player to earn increased score on kills by alternating between the different modes on compatible weapons. It also has a Epic variant that is exclusive to the R-VN "Quickening" Prototype Weapon, where in the only difference is a higher score value is given for the kills.
